question: Expected: weak/negative — same expiry-week volatility hypothesis applied to burst (breakout-from-base) triggers: breakouts occurring in expiry week (0-2 days to expiry) should show weaker or noisier follow-through than breakouts away from expiry.
plain: Testing whether breakouts that happen right around F&O monthly expiry perform worse than breakouts happening mid-month, since expiry week is known for choppy, options-driven volatility.
